en.Dragunov.Name: Dragunov
en.Dragunov.Description: A modification for various bolt-action rifles rumored to be crafted by Podderzhki Dragunov
en.Dragunov.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 9.3x64mm caliber with matching TKPD magazines
en.MXLR Unique.Name: >Endless Quick-scope<
en.MXLR Unique.Description: Even if you are not the best when shooting using iron sights, you have a lot of bullets in the magazine!
en.MXLR Unique.Explanation:
MXLR >Endless Quick-scope<
This unique variant blends the best traits of Endless and Quick-scope variant types. Despite missing a rail slot for attaching scope, it has max ergonomics, very good muzzle velocity, decreased heat factor and malfuntion chance, and, of course, massive magazine!
en.AK-308 Unique.Name: >Meta HMG<
en.AK-308 Unique.Description: It is not even that heavy!
en.AK-308 Unique.Explanation:
AK-308 >Meta HMG<
This unique variant blends the best traits of Meta and Heavy Machine Gun variant types. Full-auto fire mode only, meta stats, increased fire rate and reduced vertical recoil, but increased visible recoil
en.NL545 GP Unique.Name: >Larger Laser Rifle<
en.NL545 GP Unique.Description: When Meta gun receives Meme variant type without a downside it becomes... this:
en.NL545 GP Unique.Explanation:
NL545 GP >Larger caliber Laser Rifle<
This unique variant has a larger caliber than its basic version and statistics from the Laser Rifle variant type. 3-shot burst mode only, insane fire rate, muzzle velocity and no recoil, chambered in 7.62x39 with AKM magazines
en.Quick_MXLR_Rail.Name: M1895/MXLR Ranger Point Precision RHINO 5 inch Quick-scope ra il
en.Quick_MXLR_Rail.Description: A 5 inch top rail for MXLR {Quick-scope.Name}. It allows scopes designed specifically for {Quick-scope.Name} to be installed. Manufactured by {Trader.Nickname}
en.MXLR_Unique_mag.Name: {MXLR Unique.Name} .308 ME 100-round magazine
en.MXLR_Unique_mag.Description: A 100-round .308 ME magazine for the Marlin MXLR rifle Unique Variant.
